info.description:
HTTP RPC surface exposed by tachid.

**Daemon-native endpoints** — REST routes for validators, peer info, and health.

**Bitcoin RPC proxy** — POST / forwards a standard JSON-RPC 1.0 request straight through to the underlying bitcoind.
info.title: Tachi Daemon RPC

post.description: Forwards a JSON-RPC 1.0 request to bitcoind. Methods in readOnlyBitcoinMethods are always proxied; other methods require an X-Api-Key header matching the universal key (see SetBitcoinAPIKey).

parameters.description: Universal API key unlocking every bitcoind method beyond the common read-only set
parameters.name: X-Api-Key

get.description: Returns transactions involving the given pubkey in descending height order. Pagination is height-cursor based — pass `before_height` from the previous response's `next_before_height`. The scan is bounded by a server-side time budget, not a block cap; on cutoff the response carries partial results and a cursor.

Upgrades to a websocket. With ?address= and/or ?vault=, pushes a JSON alert (state "pending" as soon as it's accepted into the mempool via CheckTx, then again as "committed" once its block durably commits) for every transaction crediting that address or locking funds into that vault. With ?txs=true, pushes that same alert for every transaction chain-wide, unfiltered. With ?blocks=true, also pushes an alert for every durably-committed block. With ?validators=true, also pushes an alert for every new validator registration. With ?vaultId=, also pushes an alert for every watchtower-observed L1 spend of that vault's funding outpoint (legitimate, stale, or anomalous — same population as GET /tachi_watchtower/receipts). At least one filter is required. The connection is push-only; the server never expects client messages.

userSig.description:
UserSig is the vault owner's 64-byte BIP-340 signature (hex) over the
cooperative-leaf sighash. It authenticates the request as the owner's
intent before the quorum spends signing effort, and is the same signature
the caller drops into the finalized cooperative witness. Required.

is_segwit.description:
IsSegwit reports whether any input carries witness data (a non-empty
SigScript). See types.IsSegwit.

nonce.description: Nonce is the sender's transaction nonce as committed by the signer.

pubkey.description: PubKey is the hex-encoded signer public key authorizing the transaction.

size.description: Size is the byte length of the decoded raw transaction.

tx_hash.description: TxHash is the hex-encoded tmhash of the raw transaction bytes.

type.description:
Type is the human-readable TachiTx type: transfer (0x01), deposit (0x04),
withdraw (0x05), lock (0x06), unlock (0x07), vault_open (0x10),
vault_state_advance (0x11), vault_close (0x12), vault_breach (0x13), or unknown.

version.description: Version is the TachiTx protocol version byte.

vin.description: Vin lists the VTXO inputs being spent by this transaction.

vout.description: Vout lists the VTXO outputs produced by this transaction.

vsize.description: VSize is the Bitcoin-style virtual size: ceil(Weight/4). See types.VSize.

weight.description: Weight is the Bitcoin-style segwit weight: 3*baseSize + totalSize. See types.Weight.

hex.description: Hex is the hex-encoded raw transaction bytes to decode or validate.

code.description: Code is the ABCI execution code; 0 means success, non-zero means the tx failed.

log.description: Log is the ABCI execution log; "pending" for mempool txs, FinalizeBlock log otherwise.

code.description: Code is the raw ABCI CheckTx response code; non-zero indicates rejection.

log.description: Log is the human-readable CheckTx log message explaining acceptance or rejection.

valid.description: Valid is true when CometBFT CheckTx returned code 0 (transaction is acceptable).

sig_script.description: SigScript is the hex-encoded signature script authorizing the spend.

txid.description: Txid is the hex-encoded 32-byte parent transaction hash that created the VTXO.

value_sats.description: ValueSats is the satoshi value committed by the input from the spent VTXO.

vout.description: Vout is the zero-based output index within the parent transaction.

vtxo_id.description: VTXOID is the hex-encoded 32-byte identifier of the VTXO being spent.

amount.description: Amount is the value of this output in satoshis.

owner.description: Owner is the hex-encoded public key authorized to spend this output's VTXO.

script.description: Script is the hex-encoded locking script attached to the output.

amount.description: Amount is the VTXO value in satoshis.

btc_height.description:
BTCHeight is the Bitcoin L1 block height of the deposit that created
this VTXO; 0 when not a deposit or not yet populated.

btc_timestamp.description:
BTCTimestamp is the Bitcoin L1 block timestamp of the deposit that
created this VTXO; 0 when not a deposit or not yet populated.

height.description: Height is the block height at which this VTXO was created.

id.description: ID is the hex-encoded 32-byte VTXO identifier.

locked.description: Locked is true while this VTXO is bound to a vault and not freely spendable.

owner.description: Owner is the hex-encoded owner public key authorized to spend this VTXO.

script.description: Script is the hex-encoded locking script associated with this VTXO.

spent.description: Spent is true once this VTXO has been consumed by a confirmed transaction.

vault_address.description:
VaultAddress is the bech32m P2TR vault address when Locked is true
(stored as the raw bytes of the address string); empty otherwise.

amount.description: Amount is the VTXO value in satoshis.

btc_height.description:
BTCHeight is the Bitcoin L1 block height of the deposit that created
this VTXO; 0 when not a deposit or not yet populated by the L1 watcher.

btc_timestamp.description:
BTCTimestamp is the Bitcoin L1 block timestamp of the deposit that
created this VTXO; 0 when not a deposit or not yet populated.

height.description: Height is the block height at which this VTXO was created.

id.description: ID is the hex-encoded 32-byte VTXO identifier.

locked.description: Locked is true while this VTXO is locked to a vault.

owner.description: Owner is the hex-encoded owner public key authorized to spend this VTXO.

script.description: Script is the hex-encoded locking script associated with this VTXO.

spent.description: Spent is true once this VTXO has been consumed by a confirmed transaction.

vault_address.description:
VaultAddress is the bech32m P2TR vault address this VTXO is locked
to (stored as the raw bytes of the address string); empty when
Locked is false.

count.description: Count is the number of validators currently in the bootstrap registry.

host.description: Host is the CometBFT P2P address "host:port" the validator listens on.

p2p_port.description: P2PPort is the CometBFT P2P listening port advertised by the validator.

peer_id.description: PeerID is the libp2p peer identifier used by the discovery overlay.

pub_key_hex.description: PubKeyHex is the compressed secp256k1 validator public key hex used for signed registration.

rpc_addr.description: RPCAddr is the daemon RPC listen address ("host:port") this validator serves.

count.description: Count is the total number of validators in the response.

validators.description: Validators is the merged list of bootstrap-registered and KDHT-discovered validators.

address.description: bech32m P2TR vault address; the ?vault= websocket filter key

csv_delay.description:
CSVDelay, Threshold, QuorumKeyset and UserKey are the vault's
reconstruction parameters (an SDK needs them to deterministically
rebuild the vault's locking script for recovery). They disclose the
vault's spending policy, so they're only populated when the caller
authenticates with X-Api-Key (see Server.vaultAPIKeyMatches) —
omitted (zero-valued, hence dropped by omitempty) otherwise.

latest_state_num.description: LatestStateNum is always 0 today for the same reason as State.

name.description:
Name is the display label set at open. Not unique — key on VaultID.
Untrusted: chosen by the vault opener and may contain HTML
metacharacters. Escape it for the render context before displaying.

state.description:
State is always "open" today: TxVaultStateAdvance (0x11), the only writer
of closing/closed/breaching/breach_resolved, is not yet wired. Don't
build lifecycle logic on this field until state transitions land.
